_comment: BREADTH-FIRST FAST PASS to light up the 5 geography types that have geometry but no data yet (Blockgroups, Townships, School Corporations, ZIP/ZCTA, MSA). Counties + 2010 Census Tracts already have data and are live. Tiny scope (a few indicator groups that between them support all 5 levels; 1 display, 1 newest year) so each level yields a usable sample fast. The harvester auto-skips (group x level) combos the indicator doesn't support. Own output/state files -> does NOT touch the running shards or deep run. Headed (DISPLAY=:0) required for the Table.aspx popup. Resumable.
